This is 4th bail application under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.1050/2023, dated : not mentioned, registered at P.S :
Jhabua, Dist. Jhabua for offences punishable under Sections 420, 409 & 506 of IPC.
None of the application is rejected on merit.

02. According to the prosecution, the accused Rajendra approached the complainant - Prem Medha and represented himself as grain merchant and purchased the grain at the rate, which is higher than the Mandi rate i.e. Rs. 200/- per quintal above the Mandi rates.

It is further alleged that upon such representation by the accused, the complainant offered his stock of 32 quintals of Soyabean to the accused and deal for the purchase of Soyabean was fixed at Rs. 6000/- per quintals.

It was assured by the accused that, the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:31834 2 MCRC-36845-2024 payment of such purchased would be made after 8 days of delivery of goods i.e. Soyabean, which was agreed by the complainant.

After 10 days complainant approached the accused for the settlement of account of the above mentioned purchase of 32 quintals of Soyabean and in the settlement of account arrived at Rs. 1,92,000/-, upon which accused told the complainant that, such amount would be given after some time.

After few days complainant again demanded the above mentioned amount from the accused and the accused in 2-3 time has given total amount of Rs. 55,000/- and Rs. 1,37,000/- is still pending with the accused.
04. On the basis of aforesaid complaint, the present case was registered.

On 24.10.2024 counsel for the State submitted that the total amount which is due for payment to the 26 farmers is Rs.51,7033/-, out of which, Rs.7,23,000/- have been paid to the farmers and the balance amount is above Rs.43 lacs and the soyabean given by the farmers has already been sold.
05.

Counsel for the applicant was granted time to seek instruction that within what time after release the applicant will settle the dues of the farmers and shall also file a copy of the statement of bank accounts of the applicant.

Counsel for the applicant on instructions submits that the applicant shall repay the amount all the farmers of Rs.43 lacs within a period of six months from the date of release without committing any default.
He has produced copy of the statement of account which shows that there is no amount deposited in his account.
07. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this Court deems it expedient to grant the conditional bail to the applicant.

08. It is directed that applicant Rajendra Kumar shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below on the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall deposit Rs.5 lacs within 15 days from the date of release as first installment.
(ii) The applicant shall further deposit 2nd installment of Rs.5 lacs within 15 days from the date of deposit of first installment.
(iii) The applicant shall further deposit 3rd installment of Rs.5 lacs within 15 days from the date of deposit of 2nd installment.
(iv) The applicant shall further deposit 4th installment of Rs.5 lacs within 15 days from the date of deposit of 3rd installment.
